name: Northshire Scrap Metal: the kobold camp piles exist and pay out for Ingenuity At It's Finest! (#7963)
contract: Ingenuity At It's Finest! (200065, Tinker, Norman Goldshire) asks for 3 Scrap Metal (item 663320). The metal is not a kobold drop: it is gameobject 9301104, a chest whose loot is 663320 at 100% with QuestRequired, spawned at guids 7912107-7912117 in the three kobold camps and at the Echo Ridge Mine mouth. rev_20260930_99_ASC_northshire_revamp.sql deletes those guids (and the rest of the class chain) as 'stray spawns'; rev_20261007_20 restores them on a new database, but a world database that re-applies the revamp after its content changed loses them again with rev_20261007_20 still recorded as applied, so the quest has nothing to loot (#7963). rev_20261017_40_coa_northshire_class_chain_respawn.sql writes them back. Expected before: no pile is found at any camp, every DISCRIMINATING read is 0. Expected after: 3 piles at each camp and 2 at the mine mouth light up as quest objects for a Tinker on 200065, and three looted piles complete the quest. The loot actions only open a gameobject the player summoned, so copies of the pile prove the loot path while the camp reads prove the world spawns.
